newsitem.title: UK: British Vita shares up on margins pledge.
newsitem.headline: British Vita shares up on margins pledge.

text.p: Shares in British Vita Plc gained over 14 percent on Monday after the expanded foam manufacturer released an upbeat statement pledging to try to improve profit margins.
British Vita shares hit a new high for the year of 239p before slipping slightly to trade at 236p at 1140 GMT, up 27p on the day. The FTSE 100 share index was up 0.47 percent.
Traders said the share had also been lifted by analysts raising their share recommendations. Market sources said SBC Warburg lifted the stock to a "buy" from "add" previously.
"The numbers did come in above expectations and the underlying profit margin at 5.3 percent is good," said one analyst who asked not to be named.
"We seem to be seeing a turning point here...demand in Europe is recovering and clearly British Vita are focusing on higher margin areas and this strategy is set to continue," the analyst said.
